mapper.sql: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.publisher, b.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS category, b.original_price AS originalPrice, b.price, CASE b.trade_type WHEN 1 THEN '出售' WHEN 2 THEN '赠送' WHEN 3 THEN '交换' END AS tradeType, CASE b.`condition` WHEN 1 THEN '全新' WHEN 2 THEN '九成新' WHEN 3 THEN '八成新' WHEN 4 THEN '七成新及以下' END AS `condition`, b.description, b.status, CASE b.status WHEN 1 THEN '在售' WHEN 2 THEN '已预订' WHEN 3 THEN '已售出' WHEN 4 THEN '已下架' END AS statusName, b.create_time, su.id AS sellerId, su.credit AS credit, up.nickname AS seller FROM book b JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user su ON b.user_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON su.id = up.user_id AND up.deleted = 0
